title: Manager Console
subtitle: Today's attendance across your organization and pending exception/correction reviews.

pending.title: Pending Review
pending.empty: No exceptions or corrections awaiting review.

offlineTime.summary: {{action}} recorded offline at the device's time {{deviceTime}}; it reached the server at {{receivedAt}}.

mockLocation.summary: {{action}} at {{time}} from a location the device reported as simulated (fake GPS).

geofence_exception.approved: the reason is accepted - the shift's hours count in full.
geofence_exception.rejected: the hours stop counting from the moment they left the work area (the timesheet deducts the rest of that shift).
geofence_exception.clarification_requested: it goes back to the employee, with your note as the question, to explain again; it returns here when they do.

correction_request.approved: the clock-in or clock-out time is changed to the requested time.
correction_request.rejected: the recorded time stays as it is.

offline_time.approved: the time the phone recorded without a connection is accepted.
offline_time.rejected: it is marked as not accepted; the time itself doesn't change - correct it from the Attendance Record if it is wrong.

mock_location.approved: treated as a genuine location (e.g. a GPS mistake).
mock_location.rejected: recorded as a fake location; nothing else changes automatically - take it up with the employee.

geofence.summary: {{distance}} m outside the work area · reason: {{reason}}

leave.title: Leave Requests Awaiting Review
leave.reviewError: Unable to review this leave request.
leave.revokeHint: Already-approved, upcoming leave - use this if plans changed and the leave needs to be cancelled after the fact.
leave.revokeEmpty: No approved upcoming leave to revoke.
